parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. <short pause> Psalm forty-six, verse one.

Father, You are my refuge when everything feels uncertain. <short pause> You are my strength when I have none of my own. <short pause> In trouble, You are near. <short pause> Tonight I rest in that truth, sheltered and safe in You. <short pause> Amen.
